ward.summary: Mulund (ward T) used ₹39.5 lakh of its ₹51.0 lakh budget, 78%, so it stayed within budget across 65 jobs. Repairs redone within 30 days were 32%, against 24% expected for similar work, which the data rates as in line with expectations. Money spent on repairs that failed came to ₹16.8 lakh. Six jobs are listed for review, and 12 jobs, worth ₹4.6 lakh, were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should fund its 25 open issues, costing ₹9.0 lakh, starting with the manhole on Powai Adi Shankaracharya Marg and waterlogging on Devidayal Road. The remaining ₹11.5 lakh covers all of them.
